caption: Follow for more toddler-friendly recipes & save this for later! 💕 If your little one loves sweet potatoes as much as mine does, this breakfast is a must-try. It’s hearty, packed with nutrients, and super easy to throw together. 🥔 Ingredients: • 1 steamed sweet potato   • 4 eggs   • 1/4 cup Greek yogurt   • Garlic powder (optional) • Veggies of choice (I used tomatoes, zucchini & mushrooms)   • Cheese on top   Mash sweet potato to dish, mix everything else together, pour into a baking dish, top with cheese, and bake at 350°F for 30–40 minutes (until a toothpick comes out clean).
